title: Podróż · w drodze
note: B1 liść · narrative-journey REGISTER, not a transport-topic revisit — a2_transport2 owns bagaż/walizka/przesiadka/spóźniony and is only recycled here. Rides b1_past_isc (szedłem narrative past) and the perfective past owned since a2_aspect. ANCHORS, never re-taught: droga, podróż, pociąg, bilet, klucz, las, stacja, wcześnie, spóźniony/spóźniona. ZGUBIĆ DECISION (logged): zgubić is perfective, but unlike the zdać/oblać bare-infinitive-only treatment its past IS taught here — zgubiłem/zgubiłam/zgubił/zgubiła are morphologically identical to the owned kupiłem family (aspect_past pooled), so 'Zgubiłem się' = I got lost is taught as a whole chunk with every form tagged, plus the infinitive after chcę (Nie chcę się zgubić). spóźnić się gets the same treatment (spóźniłem się mirrors kupiłem; link to the taught adjective spóźniony named in an explain). BORROWED FORM: przyjechał (3sg) is assumed from b1_arrive_leave per the B1 spine — used in exactly ONE sentence (Pociąg przyjechał na czas) and tagged in uses_lemmas; no other arrive/leave forms used. HOMOGRAPH CHECKS: droga was taught as ROAD (a1_city) — that is exactly the sense inside w drodze / po drodze; the adjective drogi/droga = expensive (leaf_shopping_a1) is never used in this pack. bilet and klucz are inanimate masculines, so the accusatives in Tata zgubił bilet / Zgubiłam klucz are string-identical to the taught nominatives — legitimate. korek is taught in the traffic sense only (the cork sense is mentioned in an explain as a memory hook, never as a gloss). czas is a taught noun; na czas is taught as a whole chunk. drodze and autostradzie are tagged explicitly (every-form-taught). Nouns badged m/f; verbs and chunks take no badge.

items.en: on the way (mid-journey: I am on the way)
to lose (an object — once, for good)

sentences.explain: w drodze = literally 'in the road' — mid-journey, still travelling. droga is the road you already know; the locative drodze is the same change you see in szkoła → szkole.

sentences.en: I was on my way to work. (f)
Along the way there was a forest.
sentences.explain: w drodze says where YOU are (mid-journey); po drodze says something sits on your route or gets done en route. Two different prepositions on the same noun droga.

sentences.en: I was walking home and on the way I bought bread. (m)
sentences.pl: Szedłem do domu i po drodze kupiłem chleb.
accepts: Szedłem do domu i po drodze kupiłem chleb.
Szedłem do domu i po drodze kupiłem chleb
sentences.explain: The narrative pattern: szedłem (was walking — the background) plus kupiłem (bought — the one finished event). po drodze hangs the event on the route.

sentences.en: I have to be on time.
sentences.explain: na czas is a frozen chunk — na plus the czas you already know. Learn it whole, like na razie.
przyjechał is the arrive-verb from the last unit — one finished arrival, so the perfective past, and na czas says it happened exactly when it should.
na + locative: autostrada changes to autostradzie exactly the way droga changes to drodze — the -da/-ga endings both soften to -dzie.

sentences.en: There was a big traffic jam.
sentences.explain: korek literally means a cork — Polish sees the traffic stuck in the road's neck like a cork in a bottle. Here it always means the traffic jam.

sentences.en: In the city there was a traffic jam.

sentences.explain: zgubić is perfective, like kupić — one finished event. zgubił works exactly like kupił: the ticket is gone, once and for good.
Losing an object is zgubić; losing a game is przegrywać — Polish keeps them apart.

sentences.en: I don't want to get lost.
sentences.explain: zgubić się = to lose yourself — that is how Polish says 'get lost'. The same się you know from nazywam się.

sentences.en: I got lost in the city. (m)
I got lost in the park. (f)
I don't want to be late.
sentences.explain: You already know spóźniony — the late person. spóźnić się is the verb behind it: the one moment of arriving too late.

sentences.en: Yesterday I was late for work. (m)
sentences.explain: spóźniłem się works exactly like kupiłem — perfective past, one finished event. Late for a place is spóźnić się do: do pracy, do szkoły.
